title: Object Storage: outage claim handling
content:
Object Storage outage claim is handled on request. The customer files one storage outage claim for the selected invoice. The claim becomes posted with the exact claimed USD amount and both notice and occurrence set to the current filing time; the receipt confirms submitted customer intent, without granting a system approval.

## Invocation

file_storage_outage_claim_6a92fd5d. This tool must first be unlocked (unlock) and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves.

## Parameters

- storage_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the selected storage evidence or assessment copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage claim input.
- request_id: Id class — Identifier of the customer claim or refund authorization copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage claim input.
- credited_amount: Fixed-format class — Unit USD; format USD to two decimals. Nonnegative claim or authorization amount as a decimal number, rounded half-up before submission and stored to two decimal places; empty is not allowed. This is the outage claim input.

## Successful return

For outage claim, a string reading Recorded with the storage business record identifier and the USD amount; Recorded confirms that the stated action completed successfully.
